estimate_unit: indicative person-days, excluding waiting time and provider costs

tasks.title: Establish sources of truth and a short restart workflow
acceptance: README locates status, tasks and architecture
STATUS distinguishes delivered, planned and unverified work
AGENTS is self-contained without chat history
verification: Check links and read through the restart workflow

tasks.title: Structure the backlog and its automated validation
steps: Generate tickets and CSV from JSON
acceptance: Every ticket has steps, criteria, verification and role
Acyclic graph with no unknown dependency
Generated views match JSON
verification: Validator tests: cycle, duplicate, done without evidence, incomplete dependency

tasks.title: Choose the logo and formalize brand guidelines
steps: Provide assets, tokens, contrast and motion
acceptance: Canonical logo and provenance available
Text pairs meet 4.5:1
Reduced motion planned without losing functionality
verification: Review the four variants and lockup

tasks.title: Install the frontend foundation and shared commands
acceptance: npm ci then build succeed under the documented runtime
No secrets required for the foundation
Workshop identified as development, not a delivered course
verification: Desktop/mobile browser smoke and reduced motion

tasks.title: Prepare CI, quality and free delivery
steps: Add CI workflow and PR templates
acceptance: CI includes docs, tests, lint, typecheck and build
No unconfigured automatic deployment
Free-plan costs and limits sourced and dated

tasks.title: Install foundations in the repository and hand off
steps: Check existing files and copy without overwriting
Initialize git and record final state
acceptance: Original PDFs and variants retained
Files can be tracked in git; secrets ignored
STATUS names next task and limitations; no invented remote
evidence: Local main repository initialized; original sources verified with SHA-256

tasks.title: Translate project documentation into English and define the code comment language
steps: Translate maintained documentation, templates and canonical backlog text into English.
Translate documentation generator output and existing code comments.
Provide English companion documents for archived source PDFs while preserving the originals.
Specify English for documentation, code, identifiers and code comments.
acceptance: Maintained documentation and regenerated backlog views are in English.
All archived source PDFs have linked English text translations.
AGENTS and CONTRIBUTING explicitly require code comments in English.
The French launch interface and source archive provenance are preserved.
verification: Check generated view consistency, local links and remaining French documentation text.
Compare source archive hashes before and after translation.

tasks.title: Define the free course and its professional outcome
steps: Choose a useful office productivity task without sensitive data
Define objectives, equipment, three lessons and deliverable
acceptance: A beginner understands what they will be able to do
Plan includes observable criteria and worked solution
Author and reviewer identified before publication
verification: Review scenario and manually perform the task
evidence: Project owner explicitly approved the course plan on 2026-11-07 in this conversation.

tasks.title: Create the versioned public content schema
steps: Validate data and links at build time
acceptance: Invalid content fails the build with a precise path
Stable IDs and explicit version
Arbitrary HTML and dangerous URLs rejected
verification: Valid/invalid fixtures and rejected javascript link

tasks.title: Produce and review the complete free course
steps: Write three lessons, examples and exercises
Check accuracy, media rights and worked solutions
acceptance: Every lesson has an objective, example, exercise and worked solution
Sources/licenses recorded and reviewer identified
No paid or private content included in build
verification: Full walkthrough by someone not involved in writing

tasks.title: Build accessible course components
steps: Create buttons, fields, cards, alerts and navigation
acceptance: Visible focus and complete keyboard journey
44 px touch controls; no dependence on color alone
Loading/empty/error states documented

tasks.title: Integrate local fonts and final assets
acceptance: No Google Fonts request needed
Font-display swap; legible fallback
Logo recognizable at 24/32 px and no visible CLS

tasks.title: Deliver indexable home, catalogue and course pages
steps: Create routes and React Router navigation
acceptance: Direct URLs and refresh work
No price for undefined offers; free clearly indicated
Initial HTML contains course title and description; consistent sitemap and 404

tasks.title: Prepare French and future localization
steps: Define FR fallback and stable keys
acceptance: No misleading English selector
Dates and amounts through Intl; explicit timezone
Long text remains readable

tasks.title: Create the lesson reader
steps: Render typed blocks and previous/next navigation
acceptance: Accessible text, links and illustrations
Missing lesson displays help and a way back
No heavy media starts automatically

tasks.title: Enable practice and self-assessment
steps: Present instructions and criteria before the result
Show worked solution and ways to retry
acceptance: Self-assessment clearly named
Reading alone does not validate competence
Response and exercise usable without registration

tasks.title: Save reading progress with local consent
steps: Offer storage on a personal device
acceptance: No persisted progress without opt-in
Reload resumes after consent; erasure removes data
Denied/corrupt storage does not break reading; no deliverable retained

tasks.title: Add help, privacy and real feedback
steps: Write help and notice based on M0 data
Configure support channel and minimal feedback
acceptance: No fictional address or form
User understands local retention and host logs
Feedback requests no sensitive document or unnecessary data

tasks.title: Optimize slow networks, public PWA and motion
steps: Add manifest and public-allowlist service worker
Measure bundle and images; apply reduced motion
acceptance: Cache limited to assets and explicitly public courses
Honest offline state; new version offered without losing reading progress
No essential effect or autoplay; initial JS target ≤250 KiB gzip

tasks.title: Run acceptance testing with real testers
steps: Observe five consenting testers and fix blockers
acceptance: Course can be completed from start to finish
No unresolved critical or serious accessibility defect
Observed results and limitations recorded without invented figures
verification: M0 report with devices, scenarios and fixes

tasks.title: Publish M0 for free and test rollback
steps: Create Pages project with owner account
Deploy validated commit and test rollback
acceptance: Public HTTPS URL and deep links work
Headers and CSP verified remotely
Free quotas and version/URL/support recorded; actual rollback succeeds
verification: Production smoke and return to previous version

tasks.title: Initialize PostgreSQL, migrations and local environment
steps: Create local Supabase project and minimal schema
Define grants/RLS and reset with fictional seed
acceptance: Reproducible reset from scratch
Nonpublic tables inaccessible anonymously
Separate secrets; migration applied once
verification: SQL reset integration and per-role permissions

tasks.title: Create Hono API, OpenAPI and same-origin routing
steps: Test same-origin Static Assets and API

Worker preview contains frontend and API; no incompatible Node runtime dependency
verification: Contract tests and local/staging Worker smoke

tasks.title: Configure provider email, identity and MFA

Quotas and sender domain recorded
Explicit closed-invitation mode if SMTP unavailable
verification: External inbox and unauthorized redirect tests

tasks.title: Implement BFF sessions, rotation and CSRF protection
steps: Create opaque sessions and server token encryption
Protect CSRF, concurrent refresh and revocation
acceptance: No refresh token accessible to JS
Logout and role change actually revoke access
Hostile origin rejected; multiple-tab refresh retains a valid session
bcrypt/Argon2id deviation accepted or adapter replaced before real accounts
verification: Rotation, expiry, CSRF, multiple-tab and cookie-flag tests

tasks.title: Implement authorization and resource isolation
steps: Add RLS policies and service checks
acceptance: Deny by default; roles not user-editable
User B cannot read/modify any of A's data
Direct RPC calls do not bypass checks
verification: Hostile API/DB/storage matrix and IDOR tests

tasks.title: Log actions and limit abuse
steps: Add correlationId, audit and request limits
acceptance: Audit immutable for ordinary business roles
Brute force and large payloads limited
Logs contain no passwords, tokens or deliverables
verification: Rate-limit, payload-size tests and log inspection

tasks.title: Build account and recovery screens
steps: Render neutral errors and explicit resume
acceptance: Reset does not reveal existing accounts
Return URL must be authorized
Expired session guides reconnection without disclosure
verification: Registration, verification, reset, logout and network-error E2E

tasks.title: Import catalogue and public versions into the database
acceptance: Same content retains IDs
Drafts never accessible publicly
Referenced levels cannot be deleted; archiving preserves authorized access

tasks.title: Create learner area and synchronized progress
steps: Offer explicit import of local progress
acceptance: Two devices recover progress
Idempotent import, revocable before confirmation
Imported reading creates no validated competence

tasks.title: Create course drafts and level management
acceptance: Learners cannot edit
Concurrent save returns an explicit conflict
Editing does not modify published versions

tasks.title: Implement review, publication and archiving
acceptance: Publication requires validation and authorized role
Published correction creates a new version
Archiving removes sale without breaking existing entitlements

tasks.title: Manage private media and controlled uploads
steps: Create private bucket and authorized upload/quarantine
acceptance: Out-of-scope users retrieve neither files nor metadata
Rejected/quarantined content not served
Expired tokens and misleading types rejected
verification: Malicious upload, size, expiry and cross-account access tests

tasks.title: Version exercises, criteria and rubrics

Missed critical criterion blocks milestone
New rubric displayed before a new submission
verification: Tests where threshold is met but a critical criterion is missing

tasks.title: Submit and resume an exercise
steps: Handle interrupted network and explicit retry
acceptance: Submission freezes ExerciseVersion and RubricVersion
Retry does not create two submissions
Local draft for nonsensitive text only after opt-in; no private attachment queue
verification: Network interruption, conflict, retry and revocation E2E

tasks.title: Review work and request revision
steps: Apply rubric, feedback, appeal and history
acceptance: Only assigned trainer may review
REWORK retains the cycle rubric
Timestamped decision and appeal; reading alone never yields PASS

tasks.title: Present a course in presentation mode
steps: Create full-screen rendering from the same CourseVersion
acceptance: No private grade/submission/message projected
Same content/version as reader
Usable when full-screen mode is denied
verification: Presentation E2E and inspection for absence of private data

tasks.title: Create support and notification inbox
steps: Open minimal ticket and assign an owner
acceptance: Users see only their own tickets
Important events available without email
Support does not implicitly receive financial documents

tasks.title: Handle deletion, export and retention

Deletion revokes sessions and files under policy
Legitimate retention separate and explained; no future financial hard delete
verification: Impersonated request, deletion and cross-account export tests

tasks.title: Back up and restore database and files
steps: Export DB and inventory/objects to secure storage
acceptance: Backup does not reside in git
Files restored in addition to SQL
Time/loss measured, owner and frequency recorded

tasks.title: Test account security and accessibility
steps: Execute permission matrix and keyboard journeys
acceptance: No open critical/high vulnerability at release
Every exception has an owner and planned fix
Authenticated axe test and manual review recorded

tasks.title: Measure free-backend load and cost
steps: Measure Worker CPU, DB, latency and egress
acceptance: Test profile and region recorded
Sessions/auth fit runtime budget
Overrun plan triggers no automatic payment
verification: Gradual load with fictional data and documented costs

tasks.title: Configure environments, secrets and alerts
acceptance: Preview does not read production data
Rotatable secrets never in build/logs
Alert received and owner named
verification: Bundle leak test and simulated outage

tasks.title: Deliver the free pilot with accounts

acceptance: External tester completes registration and exercise
Public registration closed if SMTP missing
Migration-compatible rollback tested; URL/version recorded

tasks.title: Formalize commercial policies and operators

Define refunds, deadlines and external payment methods
acceptance: Prices/terms approved by named owners
Two finance people available
No-slot and late-payment cases have a customer procedure

tasks.title: Model versioned offers and distinct entitlements
acceptance: Price set by offer, not level
Future change has no effect on existing order
Beneficiary, payer and buyer distinct

tasks.title: Create idempotent orders and expiry

Same key with different payload returns 409
Expiry prevents new instructions but retains late transfers for resolution
verification: Clock, replay, different-payload and integer-XAF tests

tasks.title: Upload and review payment evidence

acceptance: Screenshot alone grants no entitlement
Rejecting an image does not declare funds unreceived
Actual type, limits and malware handling documented and tested

tasks.title: Record transactions and allocations
acceptance: Duplicate reference rejected in DB
No allocation exceeds available amount
Integer amounts and discrepancies without implicit tolerance

acceptance: Same maker/checker rejected on server
No confirmation without second verifier
Approval traces actor, source and decision; no implicit support role

tasks.title: Activate entitlements in the financial transaction

Confirmed payment opens reading even without a session
Retry duplicates neither entitlements nor credits

acceptance: Crash after commit resumes without duplicate entitlement
Unique logical notification despite repeated delivery
Payload without secrets or documents; entitlements rechecked at rendering

Apply entitlement impacts without erasing transaction
acceptance: Late transfer retained without automatic entitlement
Auditable refund and reversal with dual control
Customer sees state and next contractual step

tasks.title: Open schedule and resources

UTC stored, Africa/Douala displayed
Past/closed slots never bookable; travel included

Credit consumed at most once
Role/entitlement/capacity rechecked at commit, never only against displayed availability

Button does not promise a booking before confirmation

Absent trainer does not mark a session held
Replacement/rescheduling records decision and notifies

tasks.title: Send reminders and track assignment deadlines

Preview clearly marked unissued
Issuance permission separate from entry
